name: Turin
tagline: Royal palaces, Egyptian treasures and the home of the aperitivo
summary: Turin is Italy's elegant first capital, with arcaded boulevards, Savoy palaces and the Alps on the horizon. See the world's second-greatest Egyptian Museum, ride the lift up the Mole Antonelliana, sip a bicerin in an old café and graze through the city's generous aperitivo spreads.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are mild and clear; winter is foggy and cold but good for museums.
arrival: Turin Airport is 30 minutes by bus or train; fast trains reach Porta Nuova and Porta Susa from Milan in under an hour.
gettingAround: The centre is walkable under the arcades; trams and the metro cover the rest.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a few euros for coffee bars, tips and small shops.
foodTip: Bicerin, gianduja chocolate, agnolotti and a long aperitivo.
buyTip: Gianduiotti chocolates, vermouth and Piedmont wines.

connections.note: High-speed trains between Porta Susa and Milano Centrale.
